## Featured projects

| Project | Description |
|---|---|
| [ExploitProtection](https://github.com/neohiro/ExploitProtection) | Windows Exploit Protection settings (Ultimate) GUI |
| [dnscrypt-proxy-gui](https://github.com/neohiro/dnscrypt-proxy-gui) | Cross-platform GUI for dnscrypt-proxy |
| [Cripple-NetStrip](https://github.com/neohiro/Cripple-NetStrip) | Network hardening · DNS sinkhole · firewall · domain filter |
| [LANScan](https://github.com/neohiro/LANScan) | ARP / ICMP passive & active network scanner |
| [HoneyScan](https://github.com/neohiro/HoneyScan) | Passive honeypot for home networks |
| [SystemMonitor](https://github.com/neohiro/SystemMonitor) | Cross-platform system health monitor |

## Infrastructure

The neohiro body of work is powered by:

- **[Heart](https://github.com/neohiro/Heart)** — cadence engine (18 phases, every 5 min)
- **[Brain](https://github.com/neohiro/Brain)** — intelligence engine (auth filter, hearsay cache, token discipline)
- **[Mouth](https://github.com/neohiro/Mouth)** — output layer (3-stage contamination + addressee + table-drift validation)

See the [heartbeats dashboard](https://neohiro.github.io/heartbeats/) for live system status.
